a: Chapter 6. Of the Providence of God
Datum. 3. Calend. Mart. from Thessalonica. Grat. Valent. ~
x: “Blessed be the name of the Lord from this time forth and for evermore
Who is as our God, who dwelleth on high, and yet humbleth Himself to behold the things that are in heaven and earth?
…like our God, who dwells on high and lowers Himself toward us, so that He might see from all sides what takes place in heaven and on earth
…their blessedness and reward, but by some voluntary condescension on God’s part, which He hath been pleased to express by way of covenant
As it is said: “that which He wished, He performed
